# Signalith 0.3.2

- **Syslog survives an OpenSearch outage.** Syslog batches OpenSearch refuses for now (down, too busy, write block, 5xx, timeout) wait in a spool on the server's disk (`syslog-spool` in the state folder, 1 GB by default, `syslog.spool_mb`) and are written again, oldest first, once it takes writes, also after a restart. When the spool is full the oldest batches are dropped and counted; the Health page shows the spool and warns when it dropped events or is over half full. See [When OpenSearch is down](https://signalith.io/docs/sending-data/#when-opensearch-is-down).
